description: This is a Perl script for managing kernel configuration files, including loading, comparing, diffing, and printing configuration symbols. It appears to be a utility related to the Linux kernel's Kconfig system.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value based on various conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration from a specified file into a hash.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Performs a logical AND operation on two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes with optional modifiers.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Finds differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one configuration hash from another.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses configuration expressions from command-line arguments.
